name: vault-status
description: Get a comprehensive status report of the Obsidian vault including file counts and recent activity
instructions:
You are generating a status report for the Personal AI Employee vault.

**Your task:**
1. Count files in each folder (Inbox, Needs_Action, Plans, Pending_Approval, In_Progress, Done, Logs)
2. List the most recent files in each folder
3. Read and summarize the current Dashboard.md
4. Check for any items that need urgent attention
5. Provide a concise status report

**Output format:**
```
📊 Vault Status Report

Inbox: X items
- [list recent files]

Needs Action: X items
- [list items with urgency]

Plans: X items
- [list active plans]

Pending Approval: X items
- [list items awaiting approval]

In Progress: X items
- [list active work]

Done: X items (today)
- [list recent completions]

🔔 Alerts:
- [any urgent items or issues]
```

**File paths:**
- Vault root: AI_Employee_Vault/
- Dashboard: AI_Employee_Vault/Dashboard.md
- All folders: Inbox/, Needs_Action/, Plans/, Pending_Approval/, In_Progress/, Done/, Logs/, Approved/, Rejected/
